## Summary

```{r summary}
if (!is.null(params$comparison)) {
  n_issues <- length(params$comparison)
  if (n_issues == 0) {
    cat("✅ **PASS** - No differences found between generated and expected datasets.")
  } else {
    cat(paste("⚠️ **DIFFERENCES FOUND** -", n_issues, "issues detected."))
  }
} else {
  cat("❌ No comparison data available.")
}
```
